posts.zh:
dsh-voice-input 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。Web UI 语音输入：输入框一键麦克风按钮，基于 Web Speech API 语音转文字填入草稿，可选识别后自动发送。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-e731b99635f4b492b33c.html
posts.en:
dsh-voice-input is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Voice input for the web UI: a mic button in the composer that transcribes speech into the draft via the Web Speech API, with an optional auto-send toggle.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-e731b99635f4b492b33c.html
